newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in slow trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed amid lacklustre trading interest in Saturday's truncated session, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.487 against Friday's T$27.486 close. Turnover was a light US$50.5 million.

Dealers noted a lack of market-moving factors to boost trading. "There was nothing in the market to move the rate one direction or the other, and demand for U.S. dollar is usually light on a Saturday," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.48-52 range was seen for Monday.
